title: Transgastric Peritoneoscopy and Appendectomy
brief_summary: This study is a feasibility study. Patients with acute abdominal pain who are planning to undergo a diagnostic laparoscopy are asked to participate in the study. The aim of the study is to evaluate if transgastric peritoneoscopy is feasible.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient with acute abdominal pain

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient under 18
* Patient who cannot understand information in Swedish
* Patients previously operated in upper part of the abdomen
